questions.problem: The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=2,{x}_{2}={x}_{3}=4,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $-5.$ Find $P(x).$
questions.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=2$ and ${x}_{2}={x}_{3}=4,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-5,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =-5(x-2)(x-4)(x-4) \\  & =-5(x-2)(x-4)(x-4)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-5(x-2)(x-4)(x-4) & =-5({x}^{2}-6x+8)(x-4) \\  & =-5({x}^{3}-4{x}^{2}-6{x}^{2}+24x+8x-32) \\  & =-5({x}^{3}-10{x}^{2}+32x-32) \\  & =-5{x}^{3}+50{x}^{2}-160x+160.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=-5{x}^{3}+50{x}^{2}-160x+160.$

questions.problem: The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=2,{x}_{2}={x}_{3}=3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $-1.$ Find $P(x).$
questions.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=2$ and ${x}_{2}={x}_{3}=3,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-1,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =-1(x-2)(x-3)(x-3) \\  & =-(x-2)(x-3)(x-3)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-(x-2)(x-3)(x-3) & =-({x}^{2}-6x+9)(x-2) \\  & =-({x}^{3}-6{x}^{2}-2{x}^{2}+9x+12x-18) \\  & =-({x}^{3}-8{x}^{2}+21x-18) \\  & =-{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}-21x+18.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=-{x}^{3}+8{x}^{2}-21x+18.$

questions.problem:
The cubic polynomial $P(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=1,$ ${x}_{2}=-5,$ and ${x}_{3}=-2,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $-4.$ Find $P(x).$

$P(x)=$
{{field-1}}${x}^{3}\,-$
{{field-2}}${x}^{2}\,-$
{{field-3}}$x\,+$
{{field-4}}
questions.worked_solution:
Since our cubic polynomial has roots ${x}_{1}=1,$ ${x}_{2}=-5,$ and ${x}_{3}=-2,$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-4,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) & =-4(x-1)(x-(-5))(x-(-2)) \\  & =-4(x-1)(x+5)(x+2)\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-4(x-1)(x+5)(x+2) & =-4({x}^{2}+4x-5)(x+2) \\  & =-4({x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+4{x}^{2}+8x-5x-10) \\  & =-4({x}^{3}+6{x}^{2}+3x-10) \\  & =-4{x}^{3}-24{x}^{2}-12x+40.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $P(x)=-4{x}^{3}-24{x}^{2}-12x+40.$

questions.problem:
The cubic polynomial $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-5,{x}_{2,3}=\pm 2\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $5.$ Find $f(x).$

$f(x)=$
{{field-1}}${x}^{3}\,+$
{{field-2}}${x}^{2}\,+$
{{field-3}}$x\,+$
{{field-4}}
questions.worked_solution:
Since $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-5$ and ${x}_{2,3}=\pm 2\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=5,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =5(x-(-5))(x-2\text{i})(x-(-2\text{i})) \\  & =5(x+5)(x-2\text{i})(x+2\text{i})\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}5(x+5)(x-2\text{i})(x+2\text{i}) & = \\ 5(x+5)({x}^{2}-(2\text{i})^{2}) & = \\ 5(x+5)({x}^{2}+4) & = \\ 5({x}^{3}+5{x}^{2}+4x+20) & = \\ 5{x}^{3}+25{x}^{2}+20x+100 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=5{x}^{3}+25{x}^{2}+20x+100.$

The Argand diagram above shows the roots of the cubic polynomial $f(x).$ Find $f(x)$ given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $-2.$

$f(x)=$

{{field-2}}$x\,+$

questions.worked_solution:
From the diagram, we see that $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=2$ and ${x}_{2,3}=-1\pm 3\text{i}.$ Additionally, we're given that the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=-2.$ Therefore, we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =-2(x-2)(x-(-1+3\text{i}))(x-(-1-3\text{i}))\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}-2(x-2)(x-(-1+3\text{i}))(x-(-1-3\text{i})) & = \\ -2(x-2)({x}^{2}-x(-1-3\text{i})-x(-1+3\text{i})+(-1+3\text{i})(-1-3\text{i})) & = \\ -2(x-2)({x}^{2}+2x+10) & = \\ -2({x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+10x-2{x}^{2}-4x-20) & = \\ -2({x}^{3}+6x-20) & = \\ -2{x}^{3}-12x+40 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=-2{x}^{3}-12x+40.$
